The 2019 vintage is intensely concentrated, full-bodied, and boasts a complex profile of ripe black and blue fruits, floral notes of violets and lavender, and savory accents of warm crushed rocks and graphite. Aged an exceptionally long 30 months in 100% new French oak, the wine exhibits velvety, mouth-coating tannins and stunning purity, destined to age gracefully for decades.

Despite its high power (often 16% ABV), the wine maintains purity and balance. It has a wild, mineral-drenched character from the old, terraced vines on ponca soil, and is highly sought-after by collectors.
